These fixtures capture the integrated Phase 5 Talaria binary at the ultracode branch base
`be66bca4`. CLI commands used throwaway configuration and runs folders. Interactive screens
used the real binary in a 120-column pseudo-terminal with the existing contract-backed
loopback gateway; held and completed turns use controlled recorded frame inputs. No installed
gateway or provider was contacted. These are parser fixtures, not live acceptance evidence.

Text fixtures carry a recorded marker. Command exit markers record the actual process status;
the quit marker and shell prompt were read after the real terminal process exited. Token text
is replaced by token placeholders. Root paths and complete workflow-file paths are replaced
with opaque folder or file placeholders. The roster is a projection of the real JSON output:
version, provider identity/models, tier route/status, required paths, and workflow entries.
The one-agent script was accepted by the real workflow command before its gateway check.
